paragraphs.text: The Erg Desert covers western Almaaz , part of the Terisian Isles on Dominaria .

After the Flooding of Terisiare and the creation of the Sea of Almaaz , the Erg Desert came to cover almost the entire western half of the island of Almaaz . An erg is a broad, flat area of desert covered with wind-swept sand with little or no vegetative cover, and the erg of Almaaz is a very hostile place, battered by the harsh sun and offering few safe havens and oases.

The Erg Desert is home to roving bandits , stinging scorpions , outcast orcs from Wyrvil , fickle djinni , and hungry scavengers. The relentless sun during the day encourages travel during the dark hours, but the danger of a scouring sandstorm is always present. The modern-day Fallaji ride kavu into the Erg Desert.

The fractious orc kingdom of Wyrvil occupies the western half of the erg, while the city of Sumifa shelters in a river valley near the coast. East of the erg lies Fallajia , offering a less harsh climate. A few days' travel from Sumifa lies Neffia , a cave system connected to a life-saving oasis, which sheltered the Neffian people for many years. To the southwest, across one of the Lat-Nam Straits on a smaller island, lie the Borderlands .
↑ Teri McLaren - Song of Time (1996), HarperPrism
